session._engine_path_doc: ROUTE AN ORDINARY TURN THROUGH THE ENGINE ARCHITECTURE instead of the agentic tool loop. Everything behind it is wired and tested — extractor, orchestrator, writer, runtime, reporter, the intent ladder, the book keepers — and `plan <request>` runs it explicitly today. It defaults OFF because of a MEASUREMENT, not caution: the front seam scores 17/39 literal and 6/39 paraphrase on the production probe, and the failure is not refusal but DONE_BUT_FALSE — the system saying it finished over a world that disagrees. Switching the default would replace a chat flow that works with one that mistranslates most requests, which is the 'if everything works' clause not met. Flip it when the probe says so; the code path is one flag away and does not need writing.

_confirm_answers_doc: The words that grant or refuse a pending confirmation. Read by gates/answer.py, which is the ONE rule both the terminal gate and the HTTP chat ask. Anything not listed as affirmative is NOT a grant.
_nudges_doc: Mid-turn corrections injected as `_INTERNAL_` user messages. They live here because they are PROMPT CONTENT and there are two prompt paths (the REPL and the HTTP chat) that had already drifted: one named example tools and the other did not, which means they were steering the model differently. Anything measured on one path would not have held on the other, and nothing would have said so.

nudges.empty: _INTERNAL_ Your last response was empty. Please call the appropriate tool or provide a text response now.
nudges.text_only: _INTERNAL_ You responded with text but did not call any tool. You cannot perform actions by text alone — you MUST call the appropriate tool (e.g. create_vm, launch_vm, list_vms). Call the tool now.
nudges.loop_limit: _INTERNAL_ You were cut off by the tool loop limit. Continue the task from where you stopped.
